requestSummary: Plan a reusable live voice and grounded chat capability with automatic informational turn submission and cloud-portable Azure integration.
confirmedRequirements: Provide continuous natural voice interaction without manual submission for informational turns.
Show interim transcript, detect end of turn after a configurable pause, and resume listening after responses.
Require explicit confirmation before consequential actions.
Build a reusable framework capability and validate it with disposable generated-project fixtures.
Ground answers in approved versioned sources with citations and explicit unknowns.
Keep text-only and guided-only fallback functional.
Support Azure Commercial and Azure Government through the saved cloud profile and correct endpoints; Azure Government is the deployment-test target.
projectFacts: The updater is committed and synchronized at d02be571c2fe7f11c53b9be17926a4944572ca98.
LIVE-CHAT-001 is planning-required and has not been implemented.
No current governed skill owns a real-time conversational runtime.
The repository provides discovery, policy, security, testing, documentation, and Azure scaffolding skills.
No Azure discovery, provider selection, external processing, or billable operation is authorized now.
assumptions: Use local fake adapters and disposable generated projects before provider integration.
Use natural half-duplex turn taking first; barge-in is a later extension.
Transcript persistence defaults to session-only, raw audio is not retained, and spoken responses are opt-in.
Discovery runs per named subscription in the saved cloud profile and records service, model, region, quota, cost, endpoint, API version, identity, and data-boundary evidence.
Cloud processing, provisioning, deployment, commit, and push remain separately gated.
